palette.title: Vaultr: Open
palette.about: Read your Obsidian vault in a dialog (ctrl-shift-y). Again closes it. / searches, j/k move, enter opens

palette.title: Vaultr: Open in a tab
palette.about: Read your Obsidian vault in a tab of this space

palette.title: Vaultr: Open beside this pane
palette.about: Read your Obsidian vault beside the focused pane

palette.title: Vaultr: Open in the side panel
palette.about: Read your Obsidian vault in the layout's side panel. Needs a vaultr block in the panel and a tab bar that handles this command (see the README)

palette.title: Vaultr: Next vault
palette.about: Switch the open Vaultr to the next saved vault (v inside Vaultr, shift-v for the one before)

palette.title: Vaultr: Previous vault
palette.about: Switch the open Vaultr to the saved vault before this one

palette.title: Vaultr: Vaults
palette.about: Add, pick or remove a vault in the open Vaultr

palette.title: Vaultr: Reload
palette.about: Read the vault's folders and links again
